Investigate the myth of the fearsome Hugo across four cities, climb the Paradox Tower near Kazordoon and face the questions of the mad {npc:Riddler}. After being thrown into Hellgate, you find out your secret 'mathemagics' number from {npc:A Prisoner} in Mintwallin and return to the Riddler to enter the treasure room, where you take up to two of four rewards.
Overcome the wrath of a madman and endure his twisted taunts.
Oldrak, in the temple of the Plains of Havoc
The spell {spell:Levitate} or 18 {item:Parcel|Parcels} (4 floors to climb the tower and 2 more to leave Hellgate).
to cut the grass at the tower door
4 for each trip to the tower (you go there twice)
found in a dead tree north of the tower (step 2.1)
may be needed for the Mintwallin prison
only if you are the first to visit the tower that day
likewise — obtained in the game rooms of Edron, Carlin, Kazordoon, Yalahar and Thais
Plenty of food and {item:Blank Rune|Blank Runes} (the tower area is a Protection Zone: you do not regenerate health or mana)
Up to **two** of the four rewards: 10k gp ({item:Platinum Coin|100 Platinum Coins}), {item:Wand of Cosmic Energy}, 32 {item:Talon|Talons} and {item:Phoenix Egg}
Bring **all** the items (fruits and chess tokens) just in case: they are only needed if you are the first of the day, if someone has touched the levers or if there has been a floor reset.
The Paradox Tower and the whole area around it are a **Protection Zone**: you do not regenerate health or mana, but nobody can attack you either.

When asked *"What is your favourite colour?"* you can give **any colour** the first time, but you have to repeat **the same colour** later to the Riddler and to A Prisoner. If you forget, check the quest entry in your Quest Log.
Approximate times: mission 1 ≈ 25 min, mission 2 ≈ 45 min, mission 3 ≈ 20 min, mission 4 ≈ 30 min (total ≈ 2 hours).
You will hear the story of Hugo (the {creature:Demonbunny}) from four NPCs, in this order.
Go to the temple in the **Plains of Havoc**, **south-west** of Venore (and south-east of Kazordoon), and talk to {npc:Oldrak}. Say {key:hi}, {key:hugo}, {key:myth} and {key:yenny the gentle}.
Go to **Venore** and take the boat to **Edron**. At the Noodles Academy of Modern Magic talk to {npc:Zoltan}: {key:hi}, {key:yenny the gentle}, {key:crunor's caress}.
While you are there, get the chess tokens ({item:White Knight Token} and {item:Black Knight Token}): the Edron game room is below the castle.
Take the boat to **Carlin** and go to the Druid Guild to talk to {npc:Padreia}: {key:hi}, {key:crunor's caress}, {key:footnote}.

Go to **Thais** (by boat or on foot) and talk to {npc:Lubo}, north of Thais and south of Mount Sternum: {key:hi}, {key:crunor's cottage}, {key:flower guys}, {key:accident}, {key:stable}. You learn how the {creature:Demonbunny} was created.
2. Talk with Riddler #1 — getting to the Paradox Tower

First you fetch {item:Key 3899}, which is in a dead tree north of the tower. To get there you pass through a minotaur cave beneath the tower: use the {item:Shovel} to enter the cave at this spot. The cave is **west** of Kazordoon, next to the Dwarf Mines: from the main entrance of Kazordoon follow the white line on the map to a rope spot (with spiders); go **north** and go down a ramp to ground level; then continue **south**, over two bridges and past other mine entrances, to the {item:Loose Stone Pile} where you use the shovel.
In the cave there are only {creature:Minotaur|Minotaurs} and {creature:Minotaur Archer|Minotaur Archers}; on the surface, north of the tower, only {creature:Bear|Bears}.
Path from the Kazordoon entrance to the minotaur cave
Minotaur cave (floor -1): the northernmost hole leads to the key tree
Inside the cave go as far **north** as possible and use the {item:Rope} to climb up. You come out here, north of the Paradox Tower.
Use the {item:Dead Tree|dead tree} to get {item:Key 3899}.
The tree has a trap: you can lose up to 200 health and {item:Poison Gas|poison fields} may appear and block the exit (this does not always happen).

The tree area is a dead end on the surface. Go back down the same hole, cross the minotaur cave to the **south** and leave where you came in (use the {item:Rope} to climb up). Then go to the spot where the climb up the mountain starts, south of the Kazordoon entrance.
Hole (go back down to the cave)
Cave entrance (climb up with the Rope)

Go to this spot, south of the Kazordoon entrance, and climb the mountain "steps" with {spell:Levitate} (or {item:Parcel|parcels}). On the **3rd floor above ground** there are two {creature:Wyvern|Wyverns}. To climb from there, stand on the **left part** of the ledge you came up on, face **north** and levitate/use a parcel to the next floor.
The climb up the mountain to the Paradox Tower
Where to stand to climb from the Wyvern floor
If you use parcels, you need a monster or player in front of you (a Wyvern or a friend will do).
When you find 4 {item:Sacrificial Stone|Sacrificial Stones}, put a {item:Skull (Item)|skull} on each stone and step on the {item:Glowing Switch} in the middle. You are teleported to the tower.
The 4 Sacrificial Stones with skulls and the Glowing Switch in the middle
If the stones have poison fields (from whoever was there before), do not wait: put the skulls on top and step on the switch.
Next to the tower there are four *strange carvings* on the floor. **Do not step on them**: they teleport you away from the tower.
Strange carvings (do not step on them)

With the {item:Machete}, cut the {item:Jungle Grass|grass} from point **A** to point **D**. Then cut to point **B** as shown in the picture (including point **C**). Stand still at **B** and wait (~5 minutes) until the grass next to the door starts to grow back. At that moment step on **C** and run to **D**, where the stairs will have appeared. Key: light green = cut grass, dark green = grass, grey = stone/stairs, pink = switchplate, blue = where you need to be.
Diagram of the grass puzzle (points A, B, C and D)
Going through the door makes the stairs disappear again. Get the whole group inside the tower **before** you step on the switchplate. You have to repeat this puzzle every time you come to the tower.

In the next room there are bookcases and a row of levers. Set them to this position, **from left to right**: **Right, Right, Left, Left, Right, Left**. (The solution comes from reading the book {item:Tfel Thgirtfel (Book)} backwards.)

In the next room pull the lever to make a {creature:Ghoul} appear. When it steps on the right tile (the **top-left** corner) a staircase appears; go up **quickly**, because it disappears as soon as the ghoul leaves that tile. After a while the ghoul disappears and the lever returns to the start.
The Ghoul in the right spot
The stairs appear while the Ghoul is on the tile
You have to wait for the Ghoul every time you come to the tower.
In this room use {item:Key 3899} to open the door.

Put the fruits on the tables in this order, **from left to right**: {item:Melon}, {item:Banana}, {item:Cherry}, {item:Apple}, {item:Grapes}, {item:Coconut} (hint in the book {item:Fruit Sacrifices (Book)}). Pull the lever and climb the stairs that appear.
The fruits on the tables in the right order

On the back wall there are two {item:Hero Statue|statues}. Examine them and put the {item:Black Knight Token} and the {item:White Knight Token} on the right sides (as shown in the picture). Pull the lever and climb the new stairs.
Where to put the black and white knight

Talk to the {npc:Riddler}: say {key:hi}, {key:test} and {key:yes}. Answer the questions of the three seals as in the table. For the last question (*What is 1 plus 1?*) you do not know the answer yet: say **any number**. He says *WRONG!* and sends you to Hellgate — that is intended.
The Riddler at the top of the Paradox Tower
If you get any of the other questions wrong, you have to talk to him again and answer everything correctly, otherwise A Prisoner will not talk to you.

Because you got the last question wrong, you are sent to {wiki:Hellgate}. The area is not very dangerous; you do not need the Hellgate key ({item:Key 3012}), so do not waste 5k on it. Follow the maps in order.
Follow the path shown on the first five maps.
Continue with maps 6 to 9. At the end of the path on the 9th map use {spell:Levitate} **twice** and then climb the stairs.

When you climb as shown in the last map, you reach a room with a lever. It makes a bridge appear on the floor above: if there is no bridge after you use the {item:Rope}, go back and pull it. Leave through the {creature:Wasp|Wasps} cave and walk to **Ab'Dendriel**. In Ab'Dendriel you can take the boat to continue.

Following the maps you will only meet {creature:Skeleton|Skeletons}, {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls}, {creature:Rotworm|Rotworms}, {creature:Carrion Worm|Carrion Worms} and {creature:Bonelord|Bonelords}, but be ready for {creature:Elder Bonelord|Elder Bonelords}, {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons} and maybe {creature:The Evil Eye}.

In **Thais**, leave by the **north** door and go to the {wiki:Ancient Temple}, just north-west of that door. Go down **two floors**, go as far **north** as possible and go down to the {creature:Rotworm|Rotworms} floor. Head **east** and **south** and go down the ladder. On the next floor there are many poison fields (run through them and heal, or use {item:Destroy Field Rune|Destroy Field}); go down one more floor. Head **east** and **north** (careful with the {creature:Minotaur|Minotaurs}) and go down the hole marked on the map: below there are 2 {creature:Cyclops|Cyclopes}. Then follow the maps (**blue** line, from A to B) to the two stairs; go down either one and take a few steps **west**: you are at the gate of {wiki:Mintwallin}.
Route to Mintwallin: path to the ladder
Route to Mintwallin: poison fields floor
Route to Mintwallin: the hole marked with a circle
Route to Mintwallin: follow the blue line from A to B
The two ladders to the Mintwallin gate
Bring a {item:Rope} and a {item:Shovel}: the path has one-way holes.

In Ab'Dendriel take the boat to **Thais** and go to **Mintwallin**. The prison is on the **west** side of the city; {npc:A Prisoner} is **two floors up** inside the prison. You may need to open a door with {item:Key 3620}, which is in the guards' dormitories next to the south gates.

Talk to {npc:A Prisoner}: {key:hi}, {key:math}, {key:yes}, **your colour** (the same one you told the Riddler) and {key:yes}. He tells you your secret number (it is unique to each character and is shown in the Quest Log). You earn the achievement **Mathemagician**.
If he answers *"I think you are not in touch with yourself..."*, you came too early or got one of the Riddler's answers wrong.

Leave through the Mintwallin gate and do the route in reverse to the {wiki:Ancient Temple} (climb up with the {item:Rope} where needed). On the way back you can use a shortcut: follow the **red** line to a hole with 2 {creature:Bonelord|Bonelords} and then the **blue** line to the exit. From the Ancient Temple you return to Thais through the north gate.
Shortcut back: red line to the Bonelords' hole, then blue line to the exit
The shortcut is one-way only: the hole marked with the red circle drops you down, but there is nowhere to use the Rope, so it can't take you back to Mintwallin.

Go back to the Paradox Tower the same way: climb the mountain, sacrifice another **4 skulls**, do the grass puzzle and wait for the Ghoul. If someone has changed the levers or there has been a floor reset, also repeat the lever, fruit and knight puzzles.

Talk to the {npc:Riddler} ({key:hi}, {key:test}, {key:yes}) and give exactly the same answers, with **the same colour**. For the last question (*What is 1 plus 1?*) say **A Prisoner's number**. He shouts *"DAMN YOUUUU!"* and lets you into the treasure room.

In the treasure room there are 4 {item:Chest (Quest)|chests} and two rows of {item:Switchplate|switchplates}. **Each switchplate you step on DESTROYS a reward** (you see an explosion on the chest). You can walk straight or diagonally, but you always step on at least two. Step only on the two that match the rewards you do **not** want. Example: to keep 10k and 32 Talons, step on **E** and **W**; going straight up the 2nd column from the left gives you 100 Platinum Coins and 32 Talons (removes W and E).
Which rewards you get when crossing the switchplates of the blue arrows
The letters show the reward you LOSE when stepping on each switchplate
If you step on more than two switchplates you lose more than two rewards; if you step on **all** of them, you destroy everything and receive nothing.

Open the remaining chests. Then go back through the teleports, go all the way down the tower and pass the {creature:Wyvern|Wyverns} again. Go down the mountain steps (with {spell:Levitate}) to the spot where you started the climb, south of the Kazordoon entrance. Next to the tower there are also the four *strange carvings*: according to the wiki, stepping on them teleports you away from the tower.
Strange carvings (teleport you away from the tower)
You need 4 skulls, the grass puzzle and to wait for the Ghoul **every** time you go to the tower.

History: originally the rewards were {item:Red Spell Wand}, {item:Time Ring}, {item:Magician Hat} and {item:Violet Gem}; in 7.24 they became 10k gp, {item:Wooden Wand}, 32 Talons and Phoenix Egg; and at Christmas 2005 the Wooden Wand was replaced by the {item:Wand of Cosmic Energy}.
